title: AI pipeline autonomy policy (human-on-the-loop)
description: Chinh sach tu chu theo run: mode theo phase, loai thao tac duoc phep, cap task/tien API/thoi gian/GPU-gio/token, nguong canh bao, hanh vi khi cham tran, version. Mac dinh ai-pipeline: bounded_auto + gate.

policy_version.description: Version policy, vd. v1, v2. Moi lan doi policy tang version, giu ban cu (supersedes trong KG).

approved_by.description: Nguoi duyet policy tai G2 (vd. person:user).

modes.description: Mode theo phase; thieu phase thi dung default_mode.

allowed_actions.description: Loai thao tac coordinator/worker duoc phep tu dong (ngoai danh sach phai hoi nguoi).

caps.description: Tran tich luy cua run; null = khong gioi han muc do.

warn_at.description: Nguong canh bao = phan tram cap (vd. 0.8 = canh bao khi dung >=80% cap).

on_cap.description: Hanh vi khi cham tran: require_approval (hoi nguoi truoc moi hanh dong tiep), pause (de xuat pause Run, can nguoi xac nhan), stop (de xuat stop/release Run, can nguoi xac nhan). Supervisor khong tu kill/retry.

stale_worker_minutes.description: Worker khong heartbeat qua so phut nay thi supervisor canh bao im lang.
